articles.title: South Korea Breaks All-Time Heat Record as Deadly Heatwave Scorches East Asia
articles.summary: South Korea has recorded its hottest temperature ever measured — 41.4 degrees Celsius — as a powerful heatwave grips the country. This breaks the previous record set since modern weather tracking began. In some parts of the country, temperatures stayed above 40°C for three days in a row, making it extremely dangerous to be outdoors. Scientists say this kind of extreme heat is becoming more common because of climate change. Governments across East Asia have urged people to stay indoors, drink plenty of water, and look after elderly neighbours during the dangerous conditions.

lv1: What is the highest temperature South Korea recorded during this heatwave? (南韓在這次熱浪中錄得的最高氣溫是多少？)
How many days in a row did temperatures stay above 40°C in some areas? (部分地區的氣溫連續多少天超過40°C？)
lv2: Why is extreme heat dangerous for people's health, and who might be most at risk? (極端高溫為什麼對人體健康有危險？哪些人受到的影響最大？)
How might climate change be connected to record-breaking heatwaves like this one? (氣候變化與這類破紀錄熱浪有什麼關係？)
lv3: Some people believe governments should do more to protect citizens during extreme heat events, such as making air-conditioned public spaces free. Do you agree? What challenges might governments face in doing this? (有人認為政府應在極端高溫期間採取更多措施保護市民，例如開放免費冷氣公共場所。你同意嗎？政府在執行時可能面對什麼挑戰？)
If heatwaves like this become more frequent, how might they change the way people live, work, and go to school in Asia? Who will be most affected? (如果這類熱浪愈來愈頻繁，亞洲人的生活、工作和上學方式將如何改變？誰受到的影響會最大？)

articles.title: Asian Praying Mantises Declared Invasive in Europe, Threatening Local Wildlife
articles.summary: Scientists have officially labelled two types of praying mantis originally from Asia as invasive species in Europe. These insects have been spreading quickly across the continent and are now considered a serious threat to native animals and insects. Experts believe warmer temperatures caused by climate change, as well as green spaces in cities, have helped these mantises multiply and move into new areas. When a foreign species becomes invasive, it can compete with local creatures for food and space, upsetting the natural balance of an ecosystem. Researchers are calling for monitoring and action to control their spread.

lv1: Where did the praying mantises originally come from before spreading to Europe? (這些螳螂原本來自哪裏，然後才蔓延到歐洲？)
What word do scientists use to describe a species that spreads widely and harms its new environment? (科學家用什麼詞語形容一種在新環境中廣泛蔓延並造成危害的物種？)
lv2: How might climate change be helping these Asian mantises survive and spread in Europe? (氣候變化如何幫助這些亞洲螳螂在歐洲生存和蔓延？)
Why can invasive species be harmful to local wildlife, even if they are not poisonous or aggressive? (為什麼入侵物種即使沒有毒性或攻擊性，也可能對本地野生動物造成危害？)
lv3: When a non-native species arrives in a new country, some people argue we should try to remove it entirely, while others say we should simply manage it. Which approach do you think is better, and why? (當一種外來物種到達新地方，有人認為應該徹底清除，有人則認為只需加以管理。你認為哪種做法更好？為什麼？)

Humans have always moved animals and plants around the world, accidentally or on purpose. Should stricter rules be introduced to prevent the spread of invasive species? What might be the drawbacks of such rules? (人類一直有意無意地把動植物帶往世界各地。我們是否應該制定更嚴格的規定來防止入侵物種蔓延？這樣的規定可能有什麼缺點？)

articles.title: AI虛擬角色拍廣告帶貨　短劇在抖音播放逾2.5億次引熱議
articles.summary: 內地一部由人工智能（AI）製作的短劇《被裁掉的女孩》近期在抖音爆紅，累計播放量突破2.5億次。劇中兩位虛擬主角在戲外開設個人社交帳號，合共吸引逾50萬粉絲。女主角「方桃子」更發布帶貨影片，宣傳美瞳產品，廣告報價高達25萬元人民幣。事件引發社會廣泛討論：AI生成的虛擬人物能否取代真人演員？虛擬形象為商品代言，消費者又該如何判斷產品真偽與可信度？

lv1: 《被裁掉的女孩》是用什麼技術製作的？
這部短劇在抖音上的播放量達到多少次？
lv2: 虛擬AI角色為產品做廣告，與真人明星代言有什麼分別？消費者需要注意什麼？
為什麼這部AI短劇能在短時間內吸引大量觀眾和粉絲？
lv3: 如果AI虛擬角色可以完全取代真人演員和代言人，對演藝行業和普通打工者會帶來什麼影響？社會應如何應對？
當AI製作的虛擬人物開始為商品帶貨賺錢，現有的廣告法規是否足夠保護消費者？政府應否為AI廣告制定專門法規？

articles.title: 李家超：五年規劃重點在改善香港市民生活
articles.summary: 香港行政長官李家超表示，正在制定的五年發展規劃，最核心的目標是為市民的日常生活帶來切實改善。他強調，規劃不僅着眼於經濟發展，更要令普通市民在衣食住行各方面都能感受到進步。分析人士指出，此次規劃將涵蓋醫療、教育、房屋及就業等多個重要範疇，並需要政府各部門緊密合作，才能真正惠及全港市民。

lv1: 李家超說五年規劃最重要的目標是什麼？
五年規劃預計會涉及哪些市民生活的範疇？
lv2: 為什麼政府需要制定長達五年的規劃，而不是每年制定新計劃？長遠規劃有什麼好處？
要改善市民生活，政府各部門之間需要怎樣合作？可能會面對哪些困難？
lv3: 有人認為政府應優先發展經濟，也有人認為應優先改善民生福利。你認為兩者之間應如何取得平衡？
如果你有機會為香港的五年規劃提出建議，你最希望政府在哪個範疇投放更多資源？原因是什麼？
